implementation_status: partial; receipt-observed Scorch, explicit combatant tier input, current melee routing and independent Firesprite request

sources.support: Addition of Firesprite creation when defeating Scorched targets; not current numerical calibration.
Player reports no melee gain when the same blow both applies Scorch and kills. Bungie Help asked for evidence; this is not confirmation or a completed fix.

current_policy.qualification: Confirmed kill actor owns fragment; Scorch was present on victim at damage receipt observation. Scorch may have been applied by someone else. Assists without kill actor credit do not qualify; current D2 assist semantics require verification.
current_policy.death_order: Use immutable event_has_buff observation because live Scorch is removed by preceding death reaction. A later hit reaction does not retroactively qualify the same kill.
current_policy.classification: Receipt-time EntityObservation supplies player and entity/type tags through event_entity_observed + read_event_entity. Death reactions may remove the corpse or mutate tags without changing classification. Player selects Guardian; otherwise exactly one distinct combatant_tier_1..4 is required. Duplicate same-tier tags count once; rank labels are not tier mappings.
current_policy.unknown_classification: Missing/ambiguous tier or missing entity emits chorus_d2:searing_unclassified and skips the uncomputable melee leg; still requests the independently known Firesprite leg. No invented base amount or retroactive repayment.
current_policy.energy: Current base melee slot, recipient scalar and current Melee stat at kill processing. No melee gain cooldown is inferred from Firesprite cooldown.
current_policy.firesprite: Requests the shared per-owner firesprite_system; existing generation cooldown only suppresses pickup creation.
current_policy.missing_entity_observation: Unknown, observed unavailable, absent tier or conflicting tiers reports the existing unclassified event. Never re-query the live corpse to manufacture historical classification.
current_policy.firesprite_position: Classification survives corpse removal, but the shared Firesprite request still reads the current victim position. Missing position rejects the spawn without cooldown or rollback of credited melee energy.

test_normalization.confidence: unverified reference-basis hypothesis, not a current measured Searing baseline

test_recipient.note: Synthetic recipient account isolates chunk gains; this is not the full Threaded Spike ability.
